game.name: Metroid Prime Origins
game.desc: Metroid Prime Origins is a fan-made 2D "demake" of the 2002 classic Metroid Prime, reimagining the original 3D GameCube game as an 8-bit, NES-style adventure. Developed by the team at Lv. 4 GAMES with custom pixel art, sound effects, and fan-made chiptune music.
game.developer: Lv.4 GAMES, Zevroid, BRAINOS, Loeder, Bran
